mines.mine_notes: Company-owned bucket-line dredge operation on the Nechí River, Antioquia. 2025: 48,562,025 m³ processed @ 71.8 mg/m³, recovery 80%. Gross margin 46%. CMP (contract mining partners) supplied 9,869 oz (margin 11%). Nechí LOM plan 2025–2036 (12 y). FY2026 guidance: 83,000–93,000 oz; AISC $1,820–$1,920/oz; CMP margin 11–14%.
Formalized artisanal/small-scale miners supplying high-grade enriched sands to Nechí; Mineros realized an 11% margin on CMP ounces in 2025. Included so mine rows reconcile to reported 2025 total.

Underground gold mines in the Hemco concession, Nicaragua (Panama deposit + Pioneer deposit; epithermal quartz veins). 2025: 712,505 t milled @ 6.56 g/t, recovery 88%. Note: 2025 MD&A labels these 'Company's producing underground mines' within Hemco. BMP artisanal partners contributed 109,637 oz at cash cost $2,131/oz and AISC $2,260/oz (margin 35%). Hemco segment cash cost $2,045/oz, AISC $2,281/oz. FY2026 guidance: Hemco 130,000–140,000 oz; Panama & Pioneer AISC $2,000–$2,100/oz; BMP margin 39–41%.

mines.mine_notes: Co-operatives of artisanal miners at Hemco; Mineros purchases ore at 40–45% of spot price, with a 35% margin in 2025. Included so mine rows reconcile to reported 2025 total.

Underground development project at Hemco (cut-and-fill/sublevel stoping). Reserves Dec 31, 2025: 6,477 kt @ 2.86 g/t Au, 12.27 g/t Ag, 0.37% Cu, 2.61% Zn = 596 koz Au, 2,555 koz Ag, 52 Mlb Cu, 372 Mlb Zn (778 koz AuEq). Growth CAPEX allocated in 2025.

Exploration project, Chile. Mineros acquired the remaining 80% from Pan American for $40.36M in 2025 — now 100% owned via Minera Cavancha SpA. M&I resources (exclusive of reserves): 124,221 kt @ 0.55 g/t = 2,189 koz Au. 2026 drilling 7,000 m planned ($2.2M).

notes: 2025: consolidated 221,608 oz Au (89,777 oz Colombia + 131,831 oz Nicaragua) and 425,659 oz Ag; AuEq 227,481 oz. Consolidated cash cost $1,746/oz, AISC $2,032/oz. Record revenue $799.7M; net profit $145.0M; net cash position $93M. FY2026 guidance: 213,000–233,000 oz Au, cash cost $2,070–$2,170/oz, AISC $2,370–$2,470/oz (assumed gold price $4,405/oz). Gualcamayo (Argentina) sold in 2023 — excluded. Reserves Dec 31, 2025 (P&P): 2,106 koz Au (Nechí 1,245; Panama 133; Pioneer 132; Porvenir 596). Company reports in USD.

reserves_resources.detail: P&P reserves per Mineros 2025 Annual Information Form (presentation May 2026): Nechí Alluvial 1,245 koz (1,131,399 kt @ 0.03 g/t); Hemco Panama 133 koz (1,091 kt @ 3.79 g/t); Hemco Pioneer 132 koz (914 kt @ 4.49 g/t); Hemco Porvenir 596 koz (6,477 kt @ 2.86 g/t Au, 12.27 g/t Ag, 0.37% Cu, 2.61% Zn). Total 2,106 koz Au + 2,555 koz Ag + 52 Mlb Cu + 372 Mlb Zn. M&I (exclusive of reserves): Nechí 1,028 koz; Panama 114 koz; Pioneer 38 koz; Porvenir 182 koz; Luna Roja 75 koz; Leticia 33 koz; Guillermina 55 koz; La Pepa 2,189 koz.
